title: Bigelow's desert alien encounter: 'meet us in space'

tellings.quote: >> Well, Dr. told me that that he he started this aerospace company of his um uh because uh he'd had uh an alien experience of his own out in the desert and um that um uh they told him to meet them in space.

plain: Robert Bigelow, a Nevada businessman, is said to have founded his aerospace company because he met aliens in the desert and they told him to meet them in space. Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants in human bodies, tells Michels he heard this from an unnamed doctor. If true, a private space company was started on instructions from non-human visitors.
